title: EU Green Bond Standard — Readiness Review
subtitle: Internal readiness assessment for EUGBS issuance, May 2026
executive_summary: Readiness is medium overall. Use-of-proceeds alignment and taxonomy screening are strong. External reviewer selection and the impact reporting framework require material uplift before first issuance.

sections.heading: Background
sections.body: The EU Green Bond Standard came into force for new issuances from January 2026. This review assesses our readiness against the six core requirements.

subsections.heading: Use of proceeds
subsections.body: Strong — all 14 candidate projects map to taxonomy-aligned activities with ≥20% of turnover criterion met.

subsections.heading: External review
subsections.body: Partial — preferred reviewer identified but SLA and fee negotiations not complete.

subsections.heading: Impact reporting
subsections.body: Gap — no structured impact-reporting framework in place; currently ad-hoc in sustainability report.

findings.finding: Taxonomy alignment of candidate use of proceeds is 94% by value.
External reviewer SLA negotiation stalled on indemnification clauses.

recommendations.recommendation: Define an impact-reporting framework aligned with ICMA Harmonised Framework.
recommendations.rationale: Required for EUGBS compliance; referenced by external reviewer SLA.

references.title: ICMA Harmonised Framework for Impact Reporting
